import subprocess, json

entries = [
    {
        "prompt": "I moved to a new city for work and everyone here seems to already have their friend groups.",
        "response": "Starting over somewhere new, especially for work when you should be excited, can feel surprisingly lonely. It makes total sense that you would feel left out when everyone around you seems connected — but remember, a lot of those groups took years to form, and you just started day one. You don not have to force friendships or be the life of every gathering right away. Small consistent steps — a coffee invite, a colleague you sit with regularly, a local class — tend to grow into real connections over time. Meanwhile, it is okay to feel homesick or unsettled; that doesn not mean you made the wrong choice. You are planting seeds, even when you can not see them yet."
    },
    {
        "prompt": "I feel guilty for taking a mental health day when my team has a lot on their plates.",
        "response": "First off, the fact that you are checking in with yourself about when you need rest shows a lot of self-awareness. Guilt is a common companion to boundary-setting, but it doesn not mean you are doing something wrong. Your team can have a lot on their plates and you can still need a day — both things can be true. The people who truly matter in your workplace will understand that sustainability matters more than grinding through burnout. Use the day to actually rest, not just check anxiety emails. You are not a bad colleague for recognizing your limits; you are a responsible one."
    },
    {
        "prompt": "My partner and I are thinking about having kids but I am scared I would be a bad parent.",
        "response": "The fact that you are scared about being a good parent is actually one of the best signs that you could be a thoughtful one. Perfect parents do not exist, and the goal is not to never mess up — it is to show up with love, learn from mistakes, and keep trying. The anxiety you feel now shows you care deeply about this responsibility, which is a beautiful place to start. It is okay to talk through these fears with your partner, with other parents who are willing to be honest about their struggles, or even with a counselor. Parenting is not something you have to figure out alone, and asking for help along the way is part of being a good parent too."
    },
    {
        "prompt": "I have been journaling for a week and I feel like I am just writing nonsense.",
        "response": "Journaling is not a performance — there is no grader watching and no correct way to fill a page. If it feels like nonsense, that might just be your inner critic showing up because this practice is starting to feel meaningful, and that can be vulnerable. Some of the best journal entries look messy, repetitive, or incomplete to the writer. Try giving yourself permission to write badly, to use bullet points, to draw, to write one sentence and stop. The value is in the showing up and the honesty, not the literary quality. One week is also brand new in the journaling world; give yourself grace as you find what format feels right for you."
    },
    {
        "prompt": "I got into the program I applied to but now I am having cold feet.",
        "response": "Congratulations — first things first, that is genuinely something to be proud of. Getting into the program you wanted is a real achievement. Now, cold feet are actually pretty normal at this point. Standing at the edge of a new chapter, especially one you have worked hard toward, can bring up a mix of excitement and fear. That does not mean you made the wrong choice or should not want this. It is human to feel nervous before stepping into something that matters. Give yourself a moment to sit with the uncertainty without rushing to a decision. Sometimes the fear is just growth in disguise — the body saying this is important because it will change things. Trust that you can handle what comes next, even if you are not completely sure how yet."
    }
]

for entry in entries:
    json_str = json.dumps(entry)
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "scripts/add_entry.py"],
        input=json_str.encode(),
        capture_output=True
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"Error: {result.stderr.decode()}")
    else:
        print(f"Added entry: {entry[\"prompt\"][:50]}...")
'

</function>
